title: Excluding Entry from Exits Gives Positive Duration
statement: Let $C$ be a contract with entry state $e$ and exit set $X$. If $\\mathrm{some}(e)\\notin X$, then every admissible start configuration in state $e$ has strictly positive assigned running time.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a contract with entry state $e$ and exit set $X$
replaced:
Let $C$ be a contract with entry state $\mathrm{entry}$. If
$\mathrm{some}(\mathrm{entry})$ is not in its exit set, then every admissible start
configuration in the entry state has strictly positive contract time.
